title.en: Average velocity,mass flow and mass velocity
title.gu: Average Velocity,Mass Flow અને Mass Velocity

h.en: Average velocity,mass flow and mass velocity
h.gu: Average Velocity,Mass Flow અને Mass Velocity

body.en:
Definition and principle

Average velocity is volume flow divided by cross-sectional flow area. Mass flow is mass crossing a section per unit time. Mass velocity G, also called mass flux, is mass flow per unit flow area, not a velocity in m s⁻¹.

Important points

Use the actual flow area normal to motion. For variable density, the exact mass balance integrates density times normal velocity; the simple product uses a suitable uniform/mean-density model. Mass velocity units are kg m⁻² s⁻¹.Volume flow is not conserved through a compressible stream merely because mass flow is conserved.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Volume flow ને flow cross-sectional area થી ભાગતાં Average Velocity મળે છે.એકમ સમયમાં section પાર થતો mass એટલે Mass Flow. Mass Velocity G અથવા Mass Flux એટલે એકમ flow area દીઠ mass flow; તે m s⁻¹ વાળી velocity નથી.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Motion ને normal actual flow area લો.Variable density માટે exact mass balance માં density તથા normal velocity નો product integrate કરવો પડે છે.Simple product માટે યોગ્ય uniform/mean-density model જરૂરી છે.G નો એકમ kg m⁻² s⁻¹ છે.Compressible stream માં mass flow conserve થાય એટલે volume flow પણ conserve થાય એવું નથી.

અંતિમ સમીકરણ

body.en:
Definition and principle

Bernoulli’s ideal relation must be corrected for nonuniform velocity profiles, mechanical-energy loss and shaft work supplied/removed. Kinetic-energy correction α converts the section-average velocity term into its energy-equivalent form. For fully developed Newtonian laminar circular-pipe flow α=2; for many turbulent flows it is closer to 1 but is not always exactly 1.

Important points

Pressure head, elevation head and kinetic head all have units of length. Add pump head on the energy-supply side; subtract turbine head and positive loss head according to the stated direction. Total loss includes pipe friction and local fittings. Use gauge or absolute pressures consistently; vapour-pressure checks specifically need absolute values.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Nonuniform velocity profiles, mechanical-energy loss તથા supplied/removed shaft work માટે ideal Bernoulli માં corrections લેવા પડે છે.Kinetic-energy Correction α, section-average velocity ના term ને energy-equivalent બનાવે છે.Fully developed Newtonian laminar circular-pipe flow માટે α=2 છે.ઘણા turbulent flows માં તે 1 ની નજીક હોય છે, પણ હંમેશાં exactly 1 નહીં.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Pressure head, elevation head તથા kinetic head ત્રણેય length ના units ધરાવે છે.Energy-supply side પર pump head ઉમેરો; flow direction મુજબ turbine head તથા positive loss head લો.Total loss માં pipe friction તથા local fitting losses સામેલ છે.Pressure basis consistent રાખો.Vapour-pressure checks માટે absolute values જ લો.

body.en:
Aim and principle

Compare piezometric plus kinetic head at different sections; real total head may decrease due to loss.

Apparatus and connections

Varying-area transparent duct, piezometer bank, datum scale, known section areas and calibrated flow measurement.

Supervised procedure

Check air-free pressure connections and common datum. Establish permitted steady flow. Record actual piezometer levels and flow. Compute section velocities and total heads using the assigned α.Discuss loss and uncertainty rather than altering readings to force a constant line.

body.en:
Aim and principle

A fully developed laminar capillary pressure-flow relation gives dynamic viscosity.

Apparatus and connections

Straight capillary/known D and tap separation L, pressure instrument, water collection/time and thermometer.

Supervised procedure

Use clean, air-free water and record temperature. Measure corrected axial pressure difference and low-flow discharge after stability. Calculate μ, then verify Re and exclude entrance/local losses according to the rig SOP.
